questions: What evidence establishes staff availability and adequate training across the relevant processes, deadlines and time zones? The packet supplies no fixed headcount, hours or training duration.

Which clients are potentially affected by either transition, and what communication timing and content actually facilitate their preparation? Lack of a numerical threshold does not eliminate the qualitative expectation.

Does the Canada-inclusive definition justify extending expressly US-worded funding and mismatch provisions, or only provisions referring to Transition? The packet does not conclusively resolve that extension.

Does the transaction-level liquidity review represent an LC-wide review relevant to the transaction, or a separate review for each transaction? The source does not expressly require transaction-by-transaction reviews.
Does 'where appropriate' qualify only staffing arrangements or the full enhancement list? Neither attachment expressly excuses readiness assessment or makes the listed scheduling methods mandatory.

What actual difference is intended between the outcome-based and cumulative readings? Their submitted Boolean expressions are identical; optional implementation methods do not make express availability and training outcomes optional.

How will each conjunction encode inapplicability? Add or define guards for potentially affected clients, relevant settlement processes, US funding and cross-currency risk; do not equate an inapplicable control with a failed control.

Do the liquidity facts require funding actually to be available, as the source says? Several general-readiness facts describe reviewing practices and funding without clearly asserting availability; they also omit explicit cross-currency risk consideration.

What evidence supports treating all listed components as independently necessary supervisory expectations? 'Including' permits a non-exhaustive list; it does not by itself decide legal enforceability or establish that the selected list certifies overall compliance.
How will unknown facts be represented without converting missing evidence into falsehood? Boolean fact declarations alone do not specify an unknown-value policy.

Can node.eb85e437a170d93b8302d812 be repaired to provide a substantive statement and clean questions? Its embedded output instructions and prohibition language are not source evidence and do not override the positive conjunction.
Which specific transactions fall within the standard-cycle changes? The illustrative product list is not exhaustive and does not establish every instrument-specific exception.

Do assessments use the stated market dates—Canada on 27 May 2024 and the US on 28 May 2024—without inventing a common commencement date for preparation? FX T+2 remains a stated dependency, not an exemption.

Does the assessed LC also manage SFC-authorised funds? If so, the additional fund provisions may matter separately; neither the LC selected-control tests nor the issuing-department and monitoring statements establish satisfaction of those additional expectations.
